project_summary.purpose: To plant, monitor, and maintain native forest habitat as environmental mitigation for impacts associated with the Fargo-Moorhead Metropolitan Area Flood Risk Management Project (FMM Project).

scope_categories.description: Prepare 68.8 acres (Base) and 4.8 acres (Option) for planting via mowing, broadcast spray, discing, and burning.
Planting in three distinct zones: Bank Stabilization, Floodplain Forest, and Oak Savanna, using specified seed mixes (e.g., BWSR 34-262) and tree stock from regional sources.
Control woody and herbaceous invasive species within 96.5 acres (Base) and 5.6 acres (Option) of forest preservation areas using mechanical and chemical means.
Conduct 3 years of maintenance activities including mowing, mulching, spot spraying, and anti-herbivory measures. Conduct annual vegetation monitoring and submit detailed reports.
Place approximately 30 boulders at the entrance to Site 38b to prevent vehicular access.
